body:
In the leaderboard, how does it calculate my score?
i just want to know how to calculate my score.

replies.author: smitdalt
replies.body: I'm not sure about the exact values, but kills count for a certain number of points and monuments around 50 kills worth of points I think. Take this with a grain of salt though because I'm not 100% sure

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
"A person's score is calculated by multiplying their monuments by seventy-five and their kills by three halves, adding the two, and subtracting their deaths (S = 75M + 1.5K – D; "S" is the score, and "M", "K", and "D" are the monument, kill, and death counts, respectively).In other words, monuments are worth fifty times more leaderboard points than kills. Needless to say, someone who's only broken a few monuments can easily pass another player, who's gotten a couple hundred kills (but no monuments), on the leaderboards.

Also, keep in mind that the scores for each gamemode are determined separately... but I'd assume the formula is similar (I haven't checked). Hacktivism, by the way, is the one who figured out the calculations, not me." - MasterProX (https://avicus.net/forums/3e87addaa?reply=189646)
